Avg Days vs SLA colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Avg Days vs SLA] ), BLANK (), IF ( [Avg Days vs SLA] <= 0, "#026E75", "#A84545" ) )

SLA Breaches vs PY %.expression: DIVIDE ( [SLA Breaches] - [SLA Breaches PY], [SLA Breaches PY] )

Breach rate shown.expression: IF ( [Interactions] < 11, BLANK (), DIVIDE ( [SLA Breaches], [Interactions] ) )  // honest data: no rate under 11 tickets

Breach colour.expression: IF ( [Breach rate shown] > 0.2, "#A84545", "#1D2733" )  // tokens bad / text

Backing up title.expression: VAR _n = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( 'DataTable'[Category] ), [Breach rate shown] > 0.1 ) ) RETURN IF ( _n = 0, "No categories with more than 10% of tickets breaching SLA", _n & IF ( _n = 1, " category", " categories" ) & " with more than 10% of tickets breaching SLA" )

Headline Service.expression: VAR _t = [Interactions] VAR _top = TOPN ( 1, FILTER ( VALUES ( 'DataTable'[Category] ), [SLA Breaches] > 0 ), [SLA Breaches], DESC, 'DataTable'[Category], ASC ) VAR _c = MAXX ( _top, 'DataTable'[Category] ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _t ), "No tickets in this view.", FORMAT ( _t, "#,0" ) & IF ( _t = 1, " ticket; ", " tickets; " ) & FORMAT ( [SLA Compliance %], "0%" ) & " within SLA" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _c ), ".", "; " & _c & " has the most breaches." ) )

Category tickets title.expression: VAR _c = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DataTable'[Category], "All categories" ) VAR _t = [Interactions] RETURN "Tickets in " & _c & ": " & FORMAT ( _t, "#,0" ) & IF ( _t = 1, " ticket, ", " tickets, " ) & FORMAT ( [SLA Compliance %], "0%" ) & " within SLA"

Avg Resolution Days vs PY %.expression: VAR _py = [Avg Resolution Days PY] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _py ), DIVIDE ( [Avg Resolution Days] - _py, _py ) )

Resolution vs SLA text.expression: VAR _d = [Avg Days vs SLA] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), BLANK (), FORMAT ( ABS ( _d ), "0.0" ) & " days " & IF ( _d <= 0, "under", "over" ) & " on average" )

Interactions vs PY % colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Interactions vs PY %] ), BLANK (), IF ( [Interactions vs PY %] >= 0, "#026E75", "#A84545" ) )

SLA Compliance vs PY (pts) colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [SLA Compliance vs PY (pts)] ), BLANK (), IF ( [SLA Compliance vs PY (pts)] >= 0, "#13795B", "#B3261E" ) )

SLA Breaches vs PY % colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [SLA Breaches vs PY %] ), BLANK (), IF ( [SLA Breaches vs PY %] <= 0, "#13795B", "#B3261E" ) )

Avg Resolution Days vs PY % colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Avg Resolution Days vs PY %] ), BLANK (), IF ( [Avg Resolution Days vs PY %] <= 0, "#13795B", "#B3261E" ) )

Interactions Share Rest.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Share of Interactions %] ), BLANK (), 1 - [Share of Interactions %] )

Interactions Share Title.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Share of Interactions %] ), "–", FORMAT ( [Share of Interactions %], "0.0%" ) & " of all interactions" )

Interactions Change Text.expression: VAR _N = [Interactions] VAR _PY = [Interactions PY] VAR _D = _N - _PY VAR _P = DIVIDE ( _D, _PY ) VAR _Y = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Date'[Year] ) VAR _Vs = IF ( ISBLANK ( _Y ), "vs last year", "vs " & ( _Y - 1 ) ) VAR _No = IF ( ISBLANK ( _Y ), "No last year", "No " & ( _Y - 1 ) & " data" ) VAR _Sign = IF ( _D > 0, "+", IF ( _D < 0, "−", "" ) ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _N ), "–", IF ( ISBLANK ( _PY ), _No, IF ( _D > 0, "▲ ", IF ( _D < 0, "▼ ", "■ " ) ) & _Sign & FORMAT ( ABS ( _D ), "#,0" ) & " · " & _Sign & FORMAT ( ABS ( _P ), "0.0%" ) & " " & _Vs ) )

Interactions Change Font.expression: VAR _D = [Interactions] - [Interactions PY] VAR _Up = IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Channel'[Interaction Type] ) IN { "Escalations" }, -1, 1 ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( [Interactions PY] ) || _D = 0, "#4A5568", IF ( _D * _Up > 0, "#13795B", "#B3261E" ) )

Interactions Change Fill.expression: VAR _D = [Interactions] - [Interactions PY] VAR _Up = IF ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Channel'[Interaction Type] ) IN { "Escalations" }, -1, 1 ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( [Interactions PY] ) || _D = 0, "#EDF0F5", IF ( _D * _Up > 0, "#E4F4EE", "#FCEAE8" ) )

Resolution time Bar Colour.expression: VAR _X = SELECTEDVALUE ( 'DataTable'[Resolution Time (Days) Bin] ) VAR _T = [SLA Days] RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _X ) || ISBLANK ( _T ) || _X > _T, "#C5CCD8", SWITCH ( SELECTEDVALUE ( 'Channel'[Interaction Type] ), "Calls", "#3A63D8", "Chats", "#1E9C77", "Emails", "#1A93B8", "Escalations", "#E25751", "#C5CCD8" ) )

Resolution time Subtitle.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Interactions] ), "–", FORMAT ( [Interactions Within SLA], "#,0" ) & " within SLA (" & FORMAT ( [SLA Compliance %], "0.0%" ) & ") · SLA " & [SLA Days] & " days · avg " & FORMAT ( [Avg Resolution Days], "0.00" ) & " days" )

Interactions vs PY colour.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Interactions vs PY] ), BLANK (), IF ( [Interactions vs PY] >= 0, "#13795B", "#B3261E" ) )

X Axis Max Resolution time.expression: VAR _hi = MAX ( 'DataTable'[Resolution Time (Days) Bin] ) VAR _p = PERCENTILE.INC ( 'DataTable'[Resolution Time (Days) Bin], 0.99 ) VAR _t = [SLA Days] RETURN MIN ( _hi, MAX ( _p, 2 * _t ) ) + 0.5

measures: Avg Resolution Days vs PY % colour

Channel Group.expression: VAR _t = 'DataTable'[Interaction Type] VAR _n = CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'DataTable' ), ALLEXCEPT ( 'DataTable', 'DataTable'[Interaction Type] ) ) VAR _rank = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( 'DataTable'[Interaction Type] ), CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( 'DataTable' ), ALLEXCEPT ( 'DataTable', 'DataTable'[Interaction Type] ) ) > _n ) ) + 1 RETURN IF ( _rank <= 4, _t, "Other" )  // the four busiest channels, the rest as Other

Resolution Time (Days) Bin.expression: ROUNDUP ( 'DataTable'[Resolution Time (Days)], 0 )  // whole-unit bins for the histogram
